parsed.status_assessment: SHADOW_ONLY_NO_POSITIVE_OOS — every reported number is an in-sample/shadow (replay) artifact with zero chronologically sealed OOS. The council must reject all candidates as non-trading-ready pending the experiments below. This is not a promotion candidate under any gate in promote.py.

headline_findings.edge_is_sub_pip_and_gross: Top candidate AUDUSD expectancy 8.07e-06/trade, avg_win 3.24e-05, avg_loss -3.21e-05. On AUDUSD (~0.65) that win is ~0.32 pip — inside the spread. With no bid/ask fill model stated, this is almost certainly mid-price only and therefore NOT net of spread/slippage, violating the project's net-of-cost rule.
headline_findings.edge_is_winrate_not_payout: avg_win and |avg_loss| are near-symmetric (~3.2e-05 each). PF 1.6667 is produced entirely by a 65% win rate over a coin-flip payout: PF = (0.622*3.243e-05)/(0.378*3.205e-05) = 1.666. No directional magnitude edge exists.
headline_findings.winrate_not_significant: AUDUSD n=45, 28 wins: one-tailed binomial vs p=0.5 gives z~1.64, p~0.05. EURCAD n=31, 18 wins: z~0.90, p~0.18. Neither survives correction for 94 features x 26 symbols x horizons x sessions x regimes (~10^4+ implicit tests). The single 'hit' is expected by chance.
headline_findings.internal_incoherence: trades_per_hour=453.78 for a 45s horizon single-symbol strategy is impossible (max flat-to-flat = 3600/45 = 80/hr). Either trades overlap multi-instance, are double-counted, or the horizon/throughput fields are inconsistent — a calibration/data-integrity failure that invalidates the net_per_hour extrapolation (0.37%/hr is meaningless until reconciled).
headline_findings.time_to_green_signature: best_time_to_green=1.0s, AUDUSD median_time_to_green=6.0s on a 45s horizon. Edge is captured in the first 1-6 seconds — the classic signature of bid/ask bounce / immediate quote mean-reversion / spread capture, NOT sustained directional alpha.

hypotheses.statement: The entire apparent edge is an artifact of mid-price measurement (not net of spread/slippage).
hypotheses.rejection_gate: Re-run shadow with bid/ask fill + slippage. If PF collapses below 1.05 or expectancy turns negative on ALL top candidates, H1 accepted (edge is illusory) and candidates rejected.

hypotheses.statement: Edge is concentrated in the first 1-6 seconds (time_to_green) and reflects quote bounce / microstructure mean-reversion, not predictive signal.
hypotheses.rejection_gate: If expectancy at t>10s is statistically indistinguishable from zero while t<=6s is positive, H2 accepted; directional-alpha hypothesis rejected.

hypotheses.statement: trades_per_hour=453 vs horizon=45s indicates a measurement/labeling bug (overlapping trades, multi-instance double count, or field mismatch).
hypotheses.rejection_gate: If max achievable throughput given horizon and single-position constraint is <=80/hr yet reported is 453/hr, H3 accepted: net_per_hour and trades_per_hour fields are unreliable and must be recomputed before any use.

hypotheses.statement: Any residual edge is concentrated in tight-spread, normal_volatility, new_york sessions and vanishes in wide-spread/illiquid regimes.
hypotheses.rejection_gate: Condition PF by spread_zscore quintile. If top-quintile (tight) carries >90% of edge and wide-spread quintiles are negative, H4 accepted and strategy is regime-fragile.

loss_autopsies.candidate: AUDUSD buy / NY / normal_vol / m1_range / horizon45 / captured_exit_replay
loss_autopsies.microstructure_interpretation: Tail magnitudes are <0.3 pip — dominated by measurement noise, not real adverse selection. In live fill these would be WORSE: adverse exits pay full spread + slippage, so the observed 'tail' understates true tail risk.
loss_autopsies.net_of_spread_note: Reported losses are mid-price only; true net tail loss = observed + spread + slippage on exit. Real p99 is likely 2-4x larger. Tail containment is unproven, not demonstrated.

loss_autopsies.candidate: EURCAD sell / NY / normal_vol / m1_range / horizon45 / mfe_protection
loss_autopsies.microstructure_interpretation: MFE protection holds to median 34s — nearly the full 45s horizon. Holding through the spread for 34s bleeds the bounce edge; the small positive PF likely reflects only the tight-spread subset. Tail is tight only because it never lets losers run — but that also caps winners, leaving no real EV.
loss_autopsies.net_of_spread_note: Long hold + spread bleed => net-negative once costs applied. MFE here is microstructure-harmful, not protective.

exit_recommendations.microstructure_verdict: Both hold far too long for a first-seconds bounce edge. Median_time_to_green=6s means the trade is already 'green' early; continuing to 34-45s only exposes spread/slippage decay.
exit_recommendations.recommended_policy: Microstructure-aware quick exit: exit at first_green + half-spread buffer (target ~1-3s), NOT MFE protection. If the edge is genuine bounce, capturing the spread immediately is the only defensible exit; if it is NOT genuine, no exit policy salvages it.
exit_recommendations.caveat: Recommended policy is still gross-of-cost. It must be re-validated under H1's bid/ask fill model. If net-of-spread the quick-exit wins also vanish, the strategy has no exit that works — i.e., no strategy.

feature_tests.rationale: If edge is sub-spread, it should correlate with tight spread; this is the primary discriminator for H1/H4.
feature_tests.test: Rank PF by spread_zscore quintile across all 26 symbols.
feature_tests.expected_if_valid: Edge confined to tightest quintile; collapses in wide spreads.

feature_tests.rationale: Genuine microstructure alpha should load on order-book imbalance, not generic 'universal_quote_entry'.
feature_tests.test: Ablation: drop imbalance features, re-measure PF; if PF survives, edge is NOT imbalance-driven (suspicious).
feature_tests.expected_if_valid: PF drops materially when imbalance features removed.

feature_tests.test: Stratify by bounce indicator on/off; measure t<=6s vs t>10s expectancy.
feature_tests.expected_if_valid: Positive only when bounce present and only at t<=6s.

feature_tests.rationale: 453 trades/hr impossibility (H3) may indicate stale-quote or multi-instance artifacts.
feature_tests.test: Histogram trade inter-arrival vs horizon; flag overlaps.
feature_tests.expected_if_valid: Reveals double-count or overlapping positions explaining H3.

feature_tests.rationale: NY session concentration suggests event-driven microstructure, not persistent edge.
feature_tests.test: PF by session and by regime-transition vs steady-regime.
feature_tests.expected_if_valid: Edge concentrated at regime transitions / session opens only.

book_contradictions.claim: Shadow shows positive PF (1.58-1.67) on AUDUSD/EURCAD NY normal_vol regimes.
book_contradictions.source_to_verify: bot/intel/expected_value.jsonl and bot/intel/analogue_index.json (Book Brain) — check whether these symbols/regimes are tagged negative-EV or 'no edge' from prior research.
book_contradictions.resolution_required: If Book Brain already labels these as negative-EV, the shadow contradicts the book and the discrepancy (measurement gross-of-cost vs book net-of-cost) must be explained before ANY promotion. Champion promotion is gated by promote.py and must not proceed on shadow-only positive PF.

book_contradictions.claim: High throughput (453 trades/hr) implies a scalable high-frequency edge.
book_contradictions.source_to_verify: Prior research on sub-minute horizons for these majors (likely established as spread-dominated, no persistent edge).
book_contradictions.resolution_required: Reconcile with prior negative findings; the H3 incoherence suggests the throughput claim is a bug, not a real edge.

next_experiments.description: Re-run the full shadow with bid/ask fill model + per-symbol spread + realistic slippage + commission. This is the single most important experiment; it likely nullifies H1 candidates.
Status is NO_POSITIVE_OOS. Implement chronological sealed walk-forward (train on block T, test on untouched future block T+1). No peeking, no in-sample selection.
Current n=45 / n=31 are tiny. Increase per-cell sample to n>=2000 via longer shadow windows or pooled symbols; apply Bonferroni/Holm over all tested configurations.
Measure expectancy at each horizon [1,2,3,5,8,10,15,20,30,45]s to localize the edge and test H2 (first-seconds bounce).
gates_before_promotion: not solely t<=6s bounce that dies net-of-spread

next_experiments.description: Trace trade IDs and lifetimes to resolve the 453/hr vs 45s contradiction (H3). Fix labeling before trusting any net_per_hour figure.
gates_before_promotion: reported throughput <= theoretical max for constraint

next_experiments.description: Condition all metrics by spread_zscore quintile and volatility regime to test H4 fragility.
gates_before_promotion: edge robust across >=2 spread regimes OR explicitly documented as regime-fragile with guardrails
